highlights: Two Buck Luck won the title after entering the playoffs as the No. 4 seed at 8-7 in the regular season.
The title matched the scoring profile more than the standings seed: Two Buck Luck was the No. 4 seed but also the league's strongest regular-season scorer.
Lineup discipline was a separate story from the title race: You aren’t Worthy of Coleman managed lineups cleanest, while Two Buck Luck converted the playoff bracket.
The wire mattered most for Two Buck Luck, whose moves added the most lineup value after accounting for regret.
The detailed tables below carry the exact weekly spikes, close calls, and leaderboard values; use this section as the reading frame, not the audit trail.
The final bracket confirmed the story rather than just the seed line: Two Buck Luck beat Nacua-Cola in the title matchup.

systems.label: Top Half Wins

systems.label: Top Half Scoring Total
